how_to_apply: Submit duly filled application in the prescribed proforma as given in Annexure - I.
Fill application using blue/black ball point pen.
Super scribe the cover containing the application as 'Application for the post of 'Tutor (Music) in Rukmini Devi college of Fine Arts'.
Affix one passport size photograph on the application and provide one more separately.
Send by post along with self-attested copies of testimonials to the Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai – 600 041.
Make sure it reaches by 23 November 2026.
important_instructions: Applications received after the closing date or through email shall be summarily rejected. Candidates attending skill test should bring their own musical instruments/percussion instruments/sruti box.

content_sections.heading: Kalakshetra Foundation Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Kalakshetra Foundation notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Class Xth pass; Diploma or Degree holder in Carnatic Music from a recognized institution; Should be able to accompany dance performance of and dance dramas of Kalakshetra; Should be able to read and wrote music notations; Should be able to handle the practical and theory classes Age limit: Maximum 30 years (as on 23 November 2026) Other conditions: Must be able to accompany dance performance of and dance dramas of Kalakshetra Must be able to read and write music notations Must be able to handle practical and theory classes Desirable: Knowledge of a South Indian language BH artiste of AIR

content_sections.heading: How Will Kalakshetra Foundation Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written test (Multiple choice questions) Skill test (Carnatic Music – Vocal/Mridangam/Flute) Written test consists of 200 multiple choice questions for 200 marks with 3 hours duration. Skill test for 100 marks includes practical test in Carnatic Music – Ragas, Talas, Mano dharma sangeetham. Final merit list will comprise 40% of marks scored in written test and 60% of marks scored in skill test.

content_sections.heading: Kalakshetra Foundation Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: There will be no negative marking for wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks is 100 marks in the written test.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form with recent passport size photo One passport size photo (extra) in a cover Copy of Aadhar Proof of all educational qualifications Proof for age Testimonials for teaching/working experience Caste Certificate if age relaxation is claimed Other relevant certificates/testimonials regarding essential and desirable qualifications

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kalakshetra Foundation Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Submit duly filled application in the prescribed proforma as given in Annexure - I. Fill application using blue/black ball point pen. Super scribe the cover containing the application as 'Application for the post of 'Tutor (Music) in Rukmini Devi college of Fine Arts'. Affix one passport size photograph on the application and provide one more separately. Send by post along with self-attested copies of testimonials to the Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai – 600 041. Make sure it reaches by 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the closing date or through email shall be summarily rejected. Candidates attending skill test should bring their own musical instruments/percussion instruments/sruti box.
